description_en: It can structurally recognize the content of both the household registration page for permanent residents and the household head page, effectively extracting relevant household registration information from the household register
description_zh: 可结构化识别户口常住人口登记卡页面及户主页的内容，有效识别户口本上的相关户籍证明信息
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-household --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB11ZxTMxD1gK0jSZFsXXbldVXa-920-606.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --is-resident-page false --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeHousehold

parameters.help_en:
This field and the body field are mutually exclusive—you must provide one and only one of them.  
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive—you must provide one and only one of them.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK's body.
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether the image is from the permanent resident page of a household register. Default value: No.  
true: required; false: not required.
parameters.help_zh:
是否是户口本常住人口页，默认为否。
true：需要；false：不需要
parameters.name: is_resident_page

Code.description_en: Error code (this field is not returned if detection succeeded)
Code.description_zh: 错误码（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）
